result.fix: Run rdy as root. Adding the user to the docker group with `usermod -aG docker USER` also works. Membership of the docker group is the same as root on this host; running rdy as root once is the smaller grant. Run rdy as root, or check by hand that cgroupDriver in /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml is systemd.
result.message: docker is present, but this user may not open its socket /var/run/docker.sock, so rdy could not read its settings. The kubelet config /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml could not be read (permission denied), so the cgroup driver of docker was not compared with the kubelet's.
notes: docker: values come from /etc/docker/daemon.json, not from the running daemon
docker has a proxy set in /etc/docker/daemon.json. Image pulls go through it, so check that it can reach the registry and that no_proxy lists the cluster addresses.
